sources.entry: Tomorrow.io - AI-driven weather intelligence platform with hyperlocal forecasting and API access. #freemium

summary.name: Tomorrow.io
summary.one_liner: Tomorrow.io is a commercial weather intelligence platform that combines satellite observations, AI models and a weather API to deliver hyperlocal forecasts and sector-specific operational alerts.
use_cases: Predict hail, wind, freeze and flood risk at insured properties
Monitor runway, ramp and de-icing conditions at airports
Forecast weather-driven delays for flight schedules
Pre-position grid crews ahead of storm outages
Reroute delivery fleets around severe weather
Pull hyperlocal forecasts into apps via API
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Tomorrow.io as a space-powered AI weather platform, claiming its own commercial weather-sensing satellite constellation supplies cloud-penetrating data that is fused with global data for adaptive modeling. It offers sector-specific agentic suites for insurance, manufacturing, airports, aviation, utilities, rail, fleet logistics and on-demand delivery. The page also describes a Weather API with over 60 weather layers, including a real-time endpoint returning JSON, a forecast endpoint up to 14 days ahead, and a historical endpoint covering up to 20 years, with hourly forecasts every 15 minutes for any location. A curl example is shown for the realtime endpoint.
notable: Own commercial weather-sensing satellite constellation with cloud-penetrating data
Weather API with 60+ layers, forecast up to 14 days, historical data up to 20 years
Sector-specific agentic AI suites (insurance, aviation, grid, rail, fleet, delivery)
Real-time data available via JSON or natural language queries for AI agents
caveats: Page does not state specific free-tier limits or paid plan prices
Most content is marketing; agent answers shown are illustrative examples rather than verified outputs
Agentic suites are described for enterprise sectors, not individual users
